To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the extent of protein amidination can be determined by the colorimetric method using 1‐Fluoro‐2, 4‐dinitrobezene.

1) 1‐FDNB reacts with bisimidoester‐modified proteins to form a colored product, 2) the color intensity of the product is proportional to the extent of amidation of proteins, 3) the reaction is fast and quantitative, and 4) this colorimetric assay can be used as an effective tool to monitor the extent of crosslinking of proteins by bisimidoesters.
1‐fluor‐2,4 dinitrobenzne (1F2,4DNB), an electrophilic fluorinated reagent is a highly reactive reagent which is capable of reacting with primary and secondary amines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and characterization of new bisimidoesters and the development of a colorimetric assay to determine the extent of their reaction with proteins.
the development of a colorimetric procedure to monitor the extent of the reaction of proteins with bisimidesters.
the development of a new colorimetric method for the determination of the extent of crosslinking of proteins by bisimidoesters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the extent of reaction with 2,4‐bis(imidazole‐1‐yl)‐1,3,5‐triazine (BIT) can be followed using 1‐FDNB, while that with bisimidoacetic acid esters can be followed by using ninhydrin and that with bisimidobutyric acid esters can only be followed by using 2,4 dinitrofluorobenzene.
the extent of reaction of bisimidoesters with proteins can be followed conveniently by using this procedure.
this procedure is useful for the quantitative determination of the extent of amidation of proteins by bisimidoesters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

2,4‐DNP‐amidinated proteins are not only suitable for the colorimetric estimation of the extent of crosslinking of protein by bisimidoesters, but also for the determination of the free amino groups in proteins and for the estimation of the extent and site specificity of the modification of amino groups in proteins by other reagents such as 2,4-dinitrofluorobenzene.
the crosslinking of proteins by bisimidoesters could be monitored colorimetrically using 1‐Fluoro‐2, 4‐dinitrobenezene.

bisimidoesters are excellent crosslinking reagents for the preparation of protein conjugates, but their use should be accompanied by a simple colorimetric method to monitor the extent of the reaction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the extent of protein modification by bisimidoesters can be determined colorimetrically and the reaction can be followed in real time.
the extent of crosslinking of proteins by bisimidoesters could be determined colorimetrically using 1‐ fluorine‐2,4,‐dinitro benzene.
the reaction of proteins with bisimidesters can be followed colorimetically using the reagent 1‐fluor‐2,4 dinitrobenzine.
